newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH LEAGUE TITLE CONTENDERS WIN AWAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH LEAGUE TITLE CONTENDERS WIN AWAY.

text.p: The three main contenders for the Dutch title, PSV Eindhoven, Feyenoord and Ajax Amsterdam, all won away matches on Sunday, Ajax's victory moving them up to third spot.
But Ajax still trail leaders PSV by seven points, Eindhoven overcoming the pain of their exit from the European Cup Winners' Cup on Wednesday to come from behind before beating Twente Enschede 2-1.
PSV lead the Dutch first division with 33 points from 14 games, followed by Feyenoord with 32 and Ajax with 26 points.
After Nico-Jan Hoogma headed home a corner in the 10th minute, Luc Nilis scored the equaliser for PSV 12 minutes later, his 11th goal of the season.
Eight minutes from time, Wim Jonk made sure PSV took all three points with a powerful shot from the edge of the box.
Ajax, still suffering from a string of injuries and a tough midweek European Champions League match, also had difficulties against lowly Willem II Tilburg.
Both sides had plenty of chance but Portuguese striker Dani caught the Willem II defense napping 39 seconds after the break to score the winner and give Ajax their second away win of the season.
Feyenoord's Henk Vos scored the only goal of the match against Groningen after only four minutes when he converted a Gaston Taument cross.
